sections.section_name: Section A - Choose the Correct Answer

questions.question_text: Which of these natural objects usually has a smooth texture?
What happens when you mix blue and yellow paint?
If you draw a fish in an ocean scene, which shape is best to start its body?
When drawing 'People in Action', how do you best show someone walking?
options: B) One leg forward and one back
questions.answer: B) One leg forward and one back

questions.question_text: Which material is best for making a 3D sculpture of a bowl?
Where would you usually draw the sky in a landscape picture?
Which pattern can you easily find on a tiger?
What tool is primarily used to blend pencil shading smoothly?
When looking around your classroom, what shape is the blackboard usually?
In a drawing of a forest, how can you make trees look far away?
options: D) Put them at the bottom edge

questions.question_text: Describe the texture of a pineapple and name one other fruit with a similar feel. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: A pineapple has a very rough, bumpy, and prickly texture on the outside. Another fruit that feels rough and bumpy is a jackfruit.

questions.question_text: Name three things you would include in an 'Aqua World' drawing and their colors. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: I would include a bright orange starfish, long green seaweed swaying in the water, and a cute yellow submarine swimming near the bottom.

questions.question_text: How should you draw a person's arms and legs to show they are running fast? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: I would draw one leg bent forward and the other pushing back. The arms should swing in opposite directions to the legs to show speed.

questions.question_text: Why is it important to arrange objects carefully before starting a still-life drawing? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Arranging objects helps create a balanced picture. It ensures some items overlap nicely and the drawing doesn't look too crowded on one side.

questions.question_text: Imagine a tree made of candy. What would its trunk and leaves look like? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: The trunk would be made of a tall, twisted chocolate bar. The leaves would be fluffy pink cotton candy with colorful jellybeans for fruits.

questions.question_text: Imagine an underwater house for a friendly octopus. Describe what it looks like and what it is made of. [40-50 words]
questions.answer: The underwater house is shaped like a giant, glowing pink seashell. It is made of smooth sea glass and shiny pearls. There are eight long tunnels serving as doors, perfectly made for the octopus to slide through easily. Bright coral decorates the roof.

questions.question_text: Look around your school playground and describe how you would paint it using only three colors. [40-50 words]
questions.answer: I would use bright green to paint all the grassy fields and big trees. I would use bold red to paint the swings and climbing frames so they stand out. Finally, I would use light blue to paint the wide, beautiful morning sky above.

questions.question_text: Explain the steps you would take to create a beautiful collage of a bird using torn pieces of colored paper. [50-60 words]
questions.answer: First, I would lightly sketch the outline of a bird on a thick white sheet. Then, I would tear blue paper into small pieces for the wings and red paper for the chest. I would apply glue carefully and stick the pieces inside the outline, layering them to look like feathers.

questions.question_text: Imagine you are drawing a crowded market scene. Describe how you would show that people are busy and moving around. [50-60 words]
questions.answer: I would draw people with their arms stretched out pointing at fruits or carrying heavy shopping bags. Some characters would have their legs bent as if they are walking quickly. I would overlap the figures and draw carts moving, to make the whole picture feel active, busy, and full of life.
